## Invitations

A total of 1780 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 1098 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 61.7 per cent. The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded for the period. They should be considered together when reviewing the reach of the outreach activity and the level of participation achieved. No further interpretation of the attendance figures is included in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0. Reminder contact was also recorded as 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, providing a direct means of contact where attendance has not taken place. This activity remains part of the follow-up approach for people who did not attend. The contact figures above record SMS and reminder activity only and do not include telephone follow-up.
